summary: Astronauts use advanced medical devices and monitoring systems to measure and maintain their health while living in space. Since space has microgravity, radiation, and other dangerous conditions, astronauts must regularly check their bodies. They use wearable health monitors to measure their heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, and oxygen levels. Special devices such as electrocardiograms (ECGs) help doctors monitor their heart activity and detect any unusual changes. Astronauts also use ultrasound machines to examine their internal organs, muscles, and blood flow. Blood and urine tests help scientists check their immune system, hydration levels, and overall body condition. Cameras and fitness equipment are also used to monitor physical changes and muscle strength. Astronauts exercise daily on specially designed treadmills and bicycles to prevent muscle loss and weakening of their bones. Their health information is regularly sent to doctors and medical teams on Earth, who analyze the results and provide medical advice. In emergencies, astronauts can use medical equipment on the International Space Station to perform basic medical examinations. These technologies help astronauts stay healthy, detect medical problems early, and safely complete their missions in space.

AstroVitals – Dashboard Overview Module

 

Project: AstroVitals – Space Health & Wellbeing Platform

Module: Main Dashboard (Overview)

Target Audience: Astronauts / Mission Crew

Environment: Web Application (Frontend)

Team Name: CZNs Team

Team Members:

1. Ayaan Siddiqui.

2. Ali Hussain.

3. Rowaha Amjad.

4. Sufiyan Imran.

Overview

 

AstroVitals is a health and wellness dashboard designed to monitor users' physical and mental well-being. It provides features for exploring body organs, monitoring vital signs, tracking daily water intake, and managing health routines. The platform includes mental well-being assessments and health tests for blood pressure, blood sugar, general symptoms, and women's health. Users can also access medication and health check sections to manage their health information. Additionally, the Emergency Guide provides offline instructions to help users respond to health-related emergencies.

Functions of the Body & Organs:

 The Body & Organs page of AstroVitals provides an interactive platform for exploring human anatomy and body systems. It allows users to view the Nervous System, Skeletal System, Muscular System, and internal organs. The anatomical model highlights different body parts using interactive markers and zoom controls. Users can select organs such as the brain, heart, lungs, liver, and kidneys to explore their details. The page also displays related health observations, measurements, and exercise records. Additionally, it provides access to ultrasound records and other medical information.

Functions of the Vital Page:

 The Vitals page of AstroVitals allows users to record, monitor, and review important health measurements. It includes health indicators such as heart rate, blood pressure, blood glucose, oxygen saturation, temperature, respiratory rate, sleep duration, and exercise. Users can add new readings and filter health records by time period and data source. The page displays health measurements through visual graphs, showing the latest recorded values and timestamps. It also provides explanations of each health indicator and how it is measured. Additionally, the Measurement History section helps users review and track their health records over time.

 

Function of Water Intake:

The Water Intake page of AstroVitals helps users monitor and manage their daily water consumption. It displays the total water intake and progress toward a personal hydration goal. Users can log water consumption using preset amounts or enter a custom quantity. The 7-Day Water Log provides a graph to track and compare weekly water intake. Users can set and update their daily water consumption goals. The Today's Entries section displays recorded water amounts, timestamps, and allows users to delete entries. Additionally, the page supports routine reminders to encourage regular hydration habits.

 

Funtions of Mental Being :

 The Mental Wellbeing page of AstroVitals helps users monitor their emotional and psychological health through daily self-assessments. It allows users to rate their mood, stress, energy, sleep quality, isolation, and workload on a scale of 1 to 5. Users can save their daily check-ins to maintain a record of their wellbeing. The Mood Over Time section displays mood changes through graphical charts. The page also includes a support request feature where users can record their support needs. Additionally, the Mental Health Screening section provides multiple-choice tests for different mental health categories, including mood disorders and anxiety disorders.

Functions of Mental Health test :

 The Mental Health Test page of AstroVitals provides a guided self-assessment to evaluate users' mental wellbeing through 20 questions. It allows users to answer questions based on their experiences over the past two weeks using four response options. A progress bar and navigation buttons help users complete the assessment. The Assessment Summary displays the user's score, concern level, and supportive feedback. The Recent Score Trend helps users track changes in their mental wellbeing over time. Completed assessments and answers are saved in the browser, with an option to clear saved records. The page also provides safety information and encourages users to seek professional help when necessary.

 

Functions of Blood Pressure Check :

 The Blood Pressure Check page of AstroVitals provides a 10-question cardiovascular symptom assessment to help users identify possible warning signs. It evaluates symptoms experienced during the past 24 hours. The questionnaire covers severe headaches, vision changes, chest pressure or pain, and shortness of breath. Users can select responses such as No, Mild/Brief, or Persistent/Severe. A progress bar displays the number of questions answered and assessment completion. The page also provides health safety guidance and information about possible warning symptoms. It encourages users to seek professional medical attention when experiencing urgent symptoms.

 

Functions of  Blood Sugar Check :

 The Blood Sugar Check page of AstroVitals provides a 10-question assessment to help users identify possible blood sugar-related symptoms. It evaluates symptoms experienced during the past 24 hours. The questionnaire checks for unusual thirst, dry mouth, frequent urination, shakiness, sweating, and sudden hunger. It also assesses weakness, fatigue, and difficulty concentrating. Users can select multiple-choice responses to describe the severity of their symptoms. A progress bar displays the number of questions answered and overall assessment progress. The page also provides health safety guidance and encourages users to seek professional medical advice when necessary.

Functions of Symptom Checks :

 The Symptom Check page of AstroVitals provides a 30-question astronaut symptom assessment to help users identify possible health issues. It evaluates symptoms experienced during the past 24 hours across different health categories. These categories include fever and infection, liver and digestion, radiation events, heart and circulation, and brain-related warning signs. The questionnaire checks for fever, chills, sweating, shaking episodes, sore throat, cough, congestion, and unusual body aches. Users can select multiple-choice responses based on the severity of their symptoms. A progress bar tracks the number of questions answered and assessment completion. The page also provides health safety guidance to help users recognize warning signs and seek medical attention when necessary.

 

Functions of Space Precautions :

 The Space Precautions page of AstroVitals provides NASA-informed safety guidelines to help users reduce health risks during space missions. It includes radiation exposure precautions and guidance for responding to solar events. The Microgravity & Cardiovascular Health section explains how to manage physical changes caused by reduced gravity. Daily Health Protection provides recommendations for hygiene, food handling, exercise, and equipment cleaning. The Solar Event Response section outlines emergency procedures during solar events. The Sleep, Workload & Isolation section provides guidance for maintaining sleep routines and mental wellbeing. Additionally, the Vehicle Environment & Injury section covers safety measures for preventing and responding to injuries during space missions.

Functions of Women’s Health :

 The Women's Health page of AstroVitals is designed to help women monitor their menstrual and reproductive health through a self-assessment questionnaire. It allows users to identify and record symptoms such as unexpected bleeding, heavy menstrual flow, pelvic pain, and lower abdominal discomfort. The questionnaire also checks for warning signs such as faintness, weakness, and shoulder pain. Users can select multiple-choice answers based on their symptoms and experiences. A progress bar displays the number of questions answered and the assessment completion status. Overall, this page helps users become more aware of their reproductive health and recognize symptoms that may require medical attention.

 

Functions of Medications :

 The Medications page of AstroVitals is designed to help users manage and monitor their prescribed medicines in one place. It allows users to add new prescriptions and view their active or archived medications. Each medication record displays important details, including the recorded dose, administration route, schedule, and reference time zone. Users can log their medication intake to keep track of the doses they have taken. The page also provides options to edit or review medication details and maintain a dose history through the Dose Log section. Additionally, it displays reported allergy information and provides warnings related to medication safety. Overall, this page helps users organize their prescriptions, follow medication schedules, and maintain accurate medication records.

 

Functions of Routine :

 The Routine page of AstroVitals is designed to help users organize and maintain their daily health and wellness activities. It displays the overall routine completion status, allowing users to track how many scheduled tasks they have completed. The Participation Points section records points earned through completing activities and participating in wellness tasks. The page provides gentle reminders to encourage users to maintain healthy habits and follow their daily schedules. It also displays upcoming activities, such as morning measurement checks, movement sessions, and evening wellbeing check-ins. Users can mark activities as completed, skip or snooze them, and edit or delete existing tasks. Additionally, users can add new routines and view activities under Upcoming, Completed, and Skipped categories. Overall, this page helps users manage their daily schedules, monitor progress, and develop consistent healthy habits.

 

Functions of Camera :

 The Camera page of AstroVitals is designed to help users capture and document health-related observations using their device's camera. It provides a Visual Observation feature for recording images and videos related to health monitoring. Users can start the camera to capture new media or upload existing images and videos for documentation. The Activity Recording section allows users to document physical activities and related observations. The page also provides instructions for capturing clear images, using proper lighting, and reviewing media before saving. Additionally, the Demo Assessment Walkthrough offers a simulated assessment experience without requiring actual camera images. The Saved Observations section stores and displays previously recorded observations for future reference. Overall, this page helps users document, organize, and review visual health information.

 

Functions of Ultrasound :

 The Ultrasound page of AstroVitals is designed to help users upload, view, and manage ultrasound images and study files within the application. It provides an option to upload personal ultrasound studies from a device or load synthetic sample files for demonstration purposes. The Local Studies section displays the number of available ultrasound studies. Users can select an uploaded study from the Studies panel to view it in the Ultrasound Viewer. This viewer provides a dedicated space to inspect the selected ultrasound images. The page also allows users to access locally stored studies within the workspace. However, it does not provide clinical measurements, DICOM support, or medical diagnosis and interpretation.

 

Functions of Mission & Environment :

 The Mission & Environment page provides an overview of the Artemis Haven lunar mission. It displays the current mission status and mission day (Sol 31). It monitors important environmental conditions such as cabin pressure, CO₂, oxygen-related levels, temperature, humidity, and radiation. It helps operators track the habitat's environmental health and identify possible issues. The page also includes mission configuration for managing mission settings and parameters. Mission clocks help track mission time and schedules. Overall, it helps ensure a safe and controlled environment for astronauts living on the Moon.

 

Functions of Reports :

 The Reports page provides a detailed summary of the astronaut's health and medical information. It allows users to select a report period, such as the last 30 days, and filter measurements. It displays astronaut details, mission information, and report generation dates. The Recorded Indicators section shows health measurements such as heart rate, blood pressure, blood glucose, oxygen saturation, temperature, respiratory rate, sleep duration, and exercise. It also displays the latest readings, timestamps, data sources, and measurement quality. Users can export reports in CSV format or print and save them as PDF. Overall, this page helps monitor astronaut health and maintain organized medical records.
